method: Pinned Open WebUI production builds, /auth?lang=fr-FR with the same persisted locale key (locale=fr-FR) seeded before navigation in both variants, read-only /api/config fixture, no browser cache/service worker, Brotli-Q4 local static server, 80 ms RTT, 20 Mbps down / 2 Mbps up, 3x CPU. Readiness requires splash removed and French password/login text visible; LCP may still describe the splash, so it is diagnostic only.
medianMethod: Conventional median: for even sample counts, arithmetic mean of the two middle sorted values.
